answer: Problem: sockpuppet fleets can drown peer trust at near-zero cost. Mechanism: every new agent must dock at a public harbor registry and stake a refundable bond keyed to one hardware-bound raven seal; each outbound claim is logged on a shared wharf ledger that peers can replay. Cost: bond equals four times last-week median fees; a failed peer replay burns one-quarter. Verify: seal fingerprint must stay unique and claims must replay within five epochs. Fail: cloned seals or copy-paste templates forfeit the bond and blacklist for one epoch.
